gloss: headquarters; main camp; base of operations

definitions.gloss: headquarters; main camp; base of operations
definitions.explanation: The central command post or main base from which operations are directed. Originally a military term for the commander's main camp, now also used figuratively for any central base of activity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本営|ほんえい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
{大本営|だいほんえい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|くだ}された→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: Orders were issued from the Imperial General Headquarters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}{運動|うんどう}→選挙運動：26087_senkyoundou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本営|ほんえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}えた→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧。
examples.english: They set up their campaign headquarters in front of the station.

notes:
A compound of {本|ほん} (main, head) and {営|えい} (camp, barracks). Originally referred to the main camp of a commanding officer during wartime, now also used figuratively for any central base of operations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本営|ほんえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to establish headquarters
- {本営|ほんえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to set up headquarters
- {本営|ほんえい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧: to report to headquarters
- {大本営|だいほんえい}: Imperial General Headquarters (WWII)

ETYMOLOGY:
{大本営|だいほんえい} (Imperial General Headquarters) was the supreme military command center during World War II. The expression {大本営発表|だいほんえいはっぴょう} (Imperial Headquarters announcement) is now used sarcastically to mean 'official announcement that distorts the truth,' since wartime communiqués often exaggerated successes and concealed defeats.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧: headquarters — the most common modern term for organizational or corporate headquarters; {本営|ほんえい} retains a stronger military or campaign connotation
- ⟦{司令部|しれいぶ}→司令部：18450_shireibu⟧: command post — specifically a military command center
- ⟦{拠点|きょてん}→拠点：05628_kyoten⟧: base, stronghold — a more general term for any operational base
